assets.description: Three horizontal bars: open the main menu.
Left arrow: return to the previous screen.
Diagonal cross: close this surface.
Right triangle: start or resume play.
Two upright bars: pause the current session.
Circular return arrow: restart with the current setup.
Stepped cog with a clear center: settings.
Speaker and sound waves: sound effects.
Paired musical notes: music.
Four outward corners: fullscreen.
Storage disk with label and write area: save a local record.
Open folder with inward arrow: load an existing record.
Arrow into a tray: download or export.
Arrow out of a tray: upload or import.
Overlapping sheets: copy the selected content.
Unframed check: confirmed or valid state.
Stepped warning triangle with punctuation: attention required.
Framed information mark: additional explanation.
Closed shackle: unavailable or locked content.
Separated plug and cable: offline connection.
Lidded bin with two ribs: remove an item.
Bent left arrow: undo one authoring operation.
Bent right arrow: redo one authoring operation.
Key rows and long space bar: keyboard input.
Two-grip gamepad, direction cross and two buttons: controller input.
Raised index finger with tap rays: touch input.
Heart: remaining lives.
Four-point score spark: score value.
Clock face and hands: the labelled time value.
Partly filled cell frame: revealed coverage.
Three rising bars: an existing labelled signal status only.
Two linked rectangular loops: connection status.
Ribbon medal with three cut rank marks: gold award.
Ribbon medal with two cut rank marks: silver award.
Ribbon medal with one cut rank mark: bronze award.
Winged trophy and crown: mastery award.
Open shackle and discovery spark: newly unlocked content.
Up arrow: current upward movement binding.
Right arrow: current rightward movement binding.
Down arrow: current downward movement binding.
Left arrow: current leftward movement binding.
Two forward chevrons and a thrust bar: boost binding.
Brackets around an active diamond: class ability binding.
Check inside a key frame: confirm binding.
Cross inside a key frame: cancel binding.

Create a new PORTRAIT 9:16 title-background composition for the same original Reveal Line FPV Field Kit game shown in the reference. Use the attached image only to maintain our original drone design, atmosphere, colors and deliberate pixel-art material language. Output requested target 540×960 pixels, full-bleed opaque image. Recompose rather than crop the reference. Keep the UPPER 60% dark quiet navy hangar wall with extremely subtle large pixel shapes, suitable behind a five-item menu and logo added as real DOM text later. No text or labels or symbols in the image. In the LOWER 40%, a beautiful recognizable four-motor FPV quad on a timber equipment bench, amber battery strap, camera, radio transmitter, goggles and a spare battery; warm dawn lighting from a narrow open hangar door at the lower-right edge reveals a distant orchard. All objects fit within frame. Pixel art with intentional crisp clusters, restricted ink/navy/charcoal/amber/cyan/olive colors, controlled contrast, strong silhouettes. Keep detail entirely subordinate to the future menu. No photographic blur, gradients, bloom, vignette over text area, logos, lettering, UI, cursor, buttons, invented telemetry, people or copied commercial game artwork. Match the reference's world while using an intentionally separate portrait composition. Preserve square pixel edges; original production illustration.
